parents.course: Advanced Topics in Preservation & Tech Services

ns2:section.sectionText: This course focuses on time-based media materials in libraries and archives. Students will learn about the preservation and digitization of different media types – motion picture film, video, and recorded sound – as well as issues related to collection development, copyright/ownership, and the cataloging/description and arrangement of time-based multimedia objects. Graduate student questions may be sent to ischool-advising@illinois.edu
